name: Interlaced / Line-by-Line 3D Display
description: Displays that interleave left and right eye data row-by-row or column-by-column (e.g., Sharp Aquos, some polarized passive displays with interlaced encoding).
notes: Interlaced displays present a single 2D output where alternating rows or columns contain left/right eye data. The display hardware or glasses handle separation. Compatible with passive or active glasses depending on display type.

sbs.notes: VRto3D renders SBS; ReShade 3DToElse shader converts to row-interlaced.

tab.notes: VRto3D renders TaB; ReShade 3DToElse shader converts to row-interlaced.

interlaced_row.notes: Native row-interlaced output. Requires game or ReShade to render row-interlaced.

interlaced_col.notes: Native column-interlaced output. Requires game or ReShade to render column-interlaced.

sbs.notes: 3DToElse converts SBS to row or column interlaced. User selects format in ReShade.

interlaced_checkerboard.notes: Checkerboard interlacing for compatibility with certain 3D display types.

vrto3d.notes: VRto3D renders SBS or TaB, then ReShade 3DToElse shader converts to interlaced.

headtracking.notes: Most interlaced displays do not support head tracking.

setup_notes: Install ReShade on vrserver.exe (for VRto3D) or game executable.
Download 3DToElse.fx shader and place in reshade-shaders/Shaders folder.
Set 'Stereoscopic Mode Input' to 'Side by Side' or 'Top and Bottom' based on VRto3D output.
Set '3D Display Mode' to 'Row/Line Interlaced' or 'Column/Checkerboard Interlaced' based on your display.
Set display_index to target the interlaced display.
